title: Translation Specialist
description:
一、岗位基本信息（Informações Básicas da Vaga）

  1. 岗位名称（Cargo） ：巴西翻译岗（Tradutor Brasil - com funções de Operações e Administração）
  2. 所属部门（Departamento） ：京东工业 巴西本地化业务部（JD Industrial - Negócios Localizados do Brasil）
  3. 工作地点（Local de Trabalho） ：巴西（Brasil）/ 国内远程驻巴支持（Suporte Remoto China-Brasil）
  4. 岗位职责类型（Tipo de Vaga） ：全职（Tempo Integral）
  5. 核心语言要求（Requisito Linguístico Principal） ：中文、葡萄牙语流利（Fluente em Chinês e Português Brasileiro），可无障碍商务沟通、书面翻译及本地化对接
  6. 地址：São Paulo Office: Av . Paulista, 1912 - Bela Vista, São Paulo - SP , - 15⁰ andar

二、公司简介（Sobre a Empresa）

中文 ：京东工业是京东集团旗下专注于工业供应链、MRO工业品、企业采购、智能制造服务的核心业务板块，聚焦全球工业数字化供应链布局，深耕海外工业市场，为巴西本地工业企业、合作客户及上下游合作伙伴提供一站式数字化采购、供应链履约、本地化运营服务。本次巴西岗位为海外核心支撑岗，负责中巴业务对接、语言翻译、本地运营落地及日常行政统筹工作。

Português ：A JD Industrial é a principal unidade de negócios do Grupo JD.com focada em cadeias de suprimentos industriais, produtos industriais MRO, compras corporativas e serviços de fabricação inteligente. Com foco na expansão global da cadeia de suprimentos industrial digital, atende empresas industriais, clientes e parceiros do Brasil, fornecendo serviços integrados de compras digitais, execução de suprimentos e operação local. Esta vaga é essencial para apoiar a cooperação comercial entre China e Brasil, responsável por tradução linguística, operação local e gestão administrativa diária.


三、岗位职责（Responsabilidades do Cargo）

（一）双语翻译与本地化支持（Tradução Bilingue e Localização）

中文 ：负责中巴业务全流程双语翻译工作，包含商务会议口译、客户对接实时翻译、合同协议、业务方案、产品资料、规章制度等书面资料中葡互译；完成巴西业务内容本地化适配，优化语言表述，贴合本地商务场景与行业习惯，保障跨境业务沟通零障碍。

Português ：Responsável pela tradução bilingue em todo o processo de negócios entre China e Brasil, incluindo interpretação em reuniões comerciais, tradução em tempo real no atendimento a clientes, tradução mútua de contratos, planos de negócios, materiais de produtos e regulamentos. Realizar a adaptação local dos conteúdos de negócios brasileiros, otimizar as expressões linguísticas e garantir uma comunicação eficaz nos negócios transfronteiriços.


（二）海外业务运营支撑（Suporte de Operações de Negócios Internacionais）

中文 ：协助负责京东工业巴西站点及本地业务日常运营，包括工业品商品信息维护、客户需求梳理、商机跟进、业务数据统计与汇总；对接巴西本地合作方、供应商及客户，同步业务进度、反馈问题并推动落地；协助优化本地运营流程，收集巴西工业市场行情、行业动态及竞品信息，输出简易运营分析报告，支撑业务迭代优化。

Português ：Auxiliar na operação diária do site e negócios locais da JD Industrial no Brasil, incluindo manutenção de informações de produtos industriais, organização de demandas de clientes, acompanhamento de oportunidades de negócios e estatísticas de dados operacionais. Realizar interface com parceiros, fornecedores e clientes locais do Brasil, sincronizar progressos e resolver problemas de negócios. Coletar informações de mercado industrial e tendências do setor no Brasil, elaborar relatórios de análise operacional para apoiar a otimização contínua dos negócios.


（三）综合行政事务管理（Gestão Administrativa Geral）

中文 ：负责巴西业务团队日常行政工作，包含会议组织、日程统筹、文件归档、资料整理、办公事务协调；对接海内外团队的行政对接、流程报备、信息同步；负责本地业务对接记录、台账维护，协助完成月度、季度业务复盘及各类行政报表整理；统筹日常跨部门协作事务，保障海外团队高效有序运转。

Português ：Responsável pelos assuntos administrativos diários da equipe de negócios do Brasil, incluindo organização de reuniões, planejamento de agendas, arquivamento de documentos e coordenação de assuntos de escritório. Realizar interface administrativa e sincronização de informações entre equipes nacionais e internacionais. Manter registros de negócios e balanços, auxiliar na revisão mensal e trimestral de negócios e organizar relatórios administrativos, garantindo o funcionamento eficiente da equipe no exterior.


（四）其他专项工作（Outras Atividades Especiais）

中文 ：配合完成中巴跨境业务专项对接、品牌本地化推广、客户售后对接等辅助工作；完成上级交办的其他海外运营、行政及翻译相关工作。

Português ：Auxiliar na interface especial de negócios transfronteiriços, promoção local da marca e atendimento pós-venda a clientes. Executar outras tarefas relacionadas à operação internacional, administração e tradução atribuídas pela liderança.


四、任职要求（Requisitos para a Vaga）

1、语言能力（Habilidade Linguística）

中文 ：精通巴西葡萄牙语、中文，口语流利，书面功底扎实，可独立完成商务口译、专业文书笔译，无沟通障碍；熟悉中巴商务礼仪及工业行业术语，有本地化语言适配经验者优先。

Português ：Domínio fluente de Português Brasileiro e Chinês, com excelente capacidade de expressão oral e escrita. Capaz de realizar interpretação comercial e tradução de documentos profissionais de forma independente. Conhecimento em etiqueta comercial China-Brasil e terminologia do setor industrial é diferencial.


2、专业与经验（Formação e Experiência）

中文 ：本科及以上学历，葡萄牙语、国际贸易、商务运营、行政管理等相关专业优先；具备1年及以上翻译、海外运营、跨境行政相关工作经验，有工业、供应链、电商行业海外工作经验者优先；优秀应届生语言能力突出者可放宽条件。

Português ：Graduação superior completa, preferencialmente em Língua Portuguesa, Comércio Internacional, Operações Comerciais ou Administração. Experiência mínima de 1 ano em tradução, operação internacional ou administração transfronteiriça. Experiência em indústria, cadeia de suprimentos ou e-commerce é diferencial. Recém-formados com excelente habilidade linguística também são bem-vindos.


3、能力素质（Competências Profissionais）

中文 ：具备基础的业务运营、数据整理、公文处理能力，熟练使用Office办公软件；拥有良好的跨文化沟通能力、执行力及统筹协调能力，细心严谨、责任心强，可适配海外跨境工作节奏；抗压能力强，能够高效处理多线程工作；熟悉巴西本地市场、工业行业现状者优先。

Português ：Capacidade básica de operação comercial, organização de dados e processamento de documentos, domínio do pacote Office. Boa capacidade de comunicação intercultural, execução e coordenação. Atencioso, responsável e capaz de adaptar-se ao ritmo de trabalho transfronteiriço. Resistência à pressão e habilidade para lidar com múltiplas tarefas. Conhecimento do mercado local e setor industrial brasileiro é diferencial.

title: Especialista Fiscal - Bilíngue Espanhol
description:
O Profissional Tributário será responsável por gerenciar e garantir a conformidade com a legislação tributária brasileira aplicável à indústria de Call Center. Esta função exige conhecimento especializado tanto em Impostos Diretos (Imposto de Renda Pessoa Jurídica, Contribuições Sociais) quanto em Impostos Indiretos (ISS, PIS/COFINS), bem como familiaridade com as implicações fiscais específicas do setor.

Impostos Diretos

Impostos Indiretos

title: Mars Program — MBA Leadership
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international brand of Meituan, the world's leading food delivery platform. Guided by the mission of "helping people eat better and live better," we bring 15 years of Meituan's technology and operational expertise to global markets. Since launching in 2023, we have grown from Hong Kong to the Middle East and Brazil — building real value for users, merchants, and delivery partners in every community we serve.


About Mars Program

Mars Program is Keeta's flagship leadership accelerator — a strategic investment in the next generation of business leaders for Brazil. This is not a traditional hire. We are looking for high-potential talents who want to build a long-term career in Brazil, understand the food delivery business end-to-end, and grow into future leaders of this organization.


You will be assigned to one of the four core pillars of our business — Merchant, Consumer, Delivery, and Business Analytics — gaining a comprehensive, hands-on understanding of what it takes to build and scale a world-class food delivery platform.


What You'll Do

Your responsibilities will evolve across business areas, and may include:

  1. Drive merchant acquisition, activation, and retention strategies to grow Keeta's supply-side ecosystem in Brazil.
  2. Design and execute consumer growth and retention initiatives, tailoring strategies to local user behavior and market dynamics.
  3. Optimize delivery operations — improving efficiency, rider experience, and fulfillment quality in the Brazilian market.
  4. Conduct business analysis to translate data into strategic insights, supporting key decisions across functions.
  5. Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects, collaborating with local and global teams to solve real business challenges.


What We're Looking For

  • Education: Full-time international MBA required. We seek candidates who have completed or are completing a full-time MBA program, bringing a global perspective and the academic foundation to lead in a complex, fast-growing market.
  • Background: Experience in consulting, finance, tech, fast-moving consumer goods, or management trainee programs is a strong fit. Candidates from outside the industry with demonstrated high potential are equally welcome.
  • Language: Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Mindset: Humble, hands-on, curious, resilient — excited by the ambiguity of building something from scratch, not just managing what's already there.


Why Join Mars Program

O que você vai fazer

  • Estruturar problemas complexos e transformar hipóteses em análises e recomendações;
  • Analisar dados comerciais, financeiros, de clientes e de mercado;
  • Diagnosticar funis, conversão, produtividade e performance comercial;

O que procuramos

  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;

title: General Manager, Brazil
description:
What you'll do

As the General Manager for Brazil, you will have full P&L ownership of ANTA's Brazil business, with a primary focus on market development, business expansion, and sustainable growth, with a strong emphasis on the wholesale channel.

You will lead the development of the Brazil market from an early-stage business, proactively identify and develop key commercial opportunities, build a strong local customer and distribution network, and establish the organizational and operational foundation required for long-term growth.

This is a highly entrepreneurial and hands-on role. The successful candidate will be expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, make things happen with limited resources, and demonstrate strong commercial drive, ownership, and execution capability.


In this role, you will:

  • Own the overall Brazil business and deliver annual business objectives, including sales, gross margin, profitability, inventory, cash flow, and market expansion targets.
  • Develop and execute the Brazil business strategy and annual operating plan, establishing a clear path from market entry to scalable and sustainable growth.
  • Lead wholesale business development, proactively identify, acquire, and develop key distributors, retailers, key accounts, and other commercial partners.
  • Drive market expansion by actively identifying new customers, channels, territories, and business opportunities, and continuously growing ANTA's market presence in Brazil.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and business partners, leading commercial negotiations and ensuring strong execution.
  • Develop retail and other relevant sales channels where appropriate, while building an efficient and sustainable multi-channel business model.
  • Operate effectively in a fast-changing and resource-constrained environment, proactively solving problems, leveraging internal and external resources, and driving key initiatives from concept to execution.
  • Build and develop the local organization and operating infrastructure across key functions, including Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Human Resources.
  • Take full ownership of business budgeting, forecasting, inventory, cash flow, and financial performance, and continuously drive improvements in business results.
  • Recruit, develop, motivate, and lead a high-performing local team, building a strong ownership-driven and results-oriented culture.
  • Provide regular updates to Group and headquarters on business performance, market trends, competitive intelligence, key customers, and major business opportunities, together with clear recommendations.
  • Ensure the Brazil business operates in full compliance with local laws, regulations, and company policies, while effectively managing business and operational risks.
  • Undertake other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by Management from time to time.


What you'll bring

  • Strong commercial mindset with a proven entrepreneurial and hunter mentality .
  • Highly proactive, hands-on, and resourceful, with the ability to build a business with limited resources and a high degree of autonomy .
  • Strong wholesale business development capabilities, with a proven ability to identify, approach, negotiate with, and develop key customers and commercial partners.
  • Strong leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking combined with excellent execution capability and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Deep understanding of the Brazilian market, customers, and competitive landscape.
  • Passion for sports is a must.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Business, Management, or a related field; MBA is a plus.
  • 15+ years of experience in business management, commercial leadership, sales leadership, or general management.
  • Strong and proven experience in wholesale business, including distributor, retailer, key account, or channel development.
  • Proven track record of full P&L ownership and managing overall business performance.
  • Hands-on experience developing business and commercial networks in Brazil.
  • Experience in retail, sporting goods, footwear/apparel, or other consumer industries is strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience building a business, market, or organization from the ground up , particularly in a fast-growing or entrepreneurial environment.
  • Strong track record of delivering business growth through active market development and customer acquisition.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English ; Mandarin Chinese is a plus.


Travel

This role is based in Brazil and requires regular travel within Brazil to develop customers, visit business partners, support market expansion, and oversee local operations. Occasional travel to ANTA Group's global headquarters may also be required.

title: Advogado Pleno de Trabalhista SP
description:

A prática de Trabalhista do Mattos Filho atua de forma multidisciplinar, com a finalidade de propiciar a entrega de soluções especializadas e customizadas para as mais diversas realidades dos nossos clientes. Reconhecida como referência na assessoria legal na área trabalhista para empresas das mais diversas áreas, nossa equipe tem forte atuação no consultivo trabalhista, contencioso judicial e administrativo possuindo especialidade também nas áreas de remuneração de executivos e assessoria empresarial sindical. Com foco na atuação das chamadas reestruturações empresariais trabalhistas, a prática consegue combinar também, em um único olhar, as regras legais com as necessidades de seus clientes.

Local de trabalho: São Paulo


Sobre nós:

Movidos por transformar desafios jurídicos em oportunidades, somos uma marca de alta performance jurídica e parceria estratégica que oferece soluções inovadoras para problemas complexos. Referência em mais de 40 áreas do Direito , em 2024, fomos reconhecidos pela sétima vez como escritório do ano no Brasil, recordista nesta categoria, pelo Chambers & Partners. Em 2023, fomos apontados como "O escritório de advocacia do ano no Brasil" pelo The Legal 500. Estamos em São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro, Brasília, Nova Iorque e Londres.

Temos as pessoas no centro do nosso negócio , valorizamos a diversidade e investimos em nossos talentos por meio de uma gestão humanizada e integrada, pois acreditamos que a colaboração nos permite crescer juntos e chegar ainda mais longe. Por entender que a atividade jurídica é o meio, e não um fim, também realizamos e apoiamos iniciativas de impacto socioambiental . Fomos pioneiros na advocacia gratuita no país com o nosso programa de pro bono , atendendo a organizações da sociedade civil com restrições financeiras e pessoas físicas em situação de vulnerabilidade social e econômica.

title: Analista Tributário Sênior
description:
Ei, que bom te ver por aqui! 😃

Você já conhece a ZAMP?


Somos um grande ecossistema de restaurantes que reúne marcas internacionais como Burger King®, Popeyes®, Starbucks® e Subway®.


E, por trás de cada receita de sucesso, estão os Zampers: gente que faz acontecer, que joga junto e que deixa sua marca todos os dias.


Aqui, a gente acredita que o verdadeiro sabor do sucesso é ter espaço pra criar, crescer, liderar e ser quem você é. Usamos tecnologia, inovação e muita parceria para entregar experiências que surpreendem nossos clientes e geram oportunidades para o nosso time. Temos apetite pelo futuro e ousadia para conquistar novos mercados, novos sabores e novas conexões. Porque grandes marcas só existem quando grandes pessoas constroem algo maior do que elas mesmas.


Isso é a Zamp® : um ecossistema de restaurantes e pessoas em constante evolução.


*Todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência (PCD). ✅


Como será o seu desafio?


  • Atuar como referência técnica em temas tributários estratégicos, especialmente envolvendo ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL, retenções e tributos incidentes sobre importações.
  • Apoiar a liderança tributária na avaliação de impactos fiscais sobre operações comerciais, cadeias de suprimentos, centros de distribuição, lojas, contratos, serviços, royalties, importações e demais fluxos operacionais.
  • Avaliar oportunidades tributárias, créditos fiscais, regimes especiais, benefícios fiscais e teses tributárias, considerando viabilidade técnica, impactos financeiros, riscos, documentação suporte e governança.
  • Elaborar análises, pareceres internos, memorandos técnicos e materiais executivos para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Avaliar impactos tributários em linhas relevantes do negócio, como receita bruta, receita líquida, impostos sobre vendas, custos, CMV, despesas, EBITDA e fluxo de caixa.
  • Apoiar discussões relacionadas à Reforma Tributária, incluindo impactos de IBS, CBS, Imposto Seletivo, transição, créditos, precificação, margem, cash flow, sistemas e obrigações acessórias.
  • Atuar em projetos de parametrização fiscal, saneamento de cadastros, revisão de NCM, CST, CFOP, regras fiscais, natureza de operação e tributação de produtos e serviços.
  • Apoiar a revisão de obrigações acessórias, incluindo SPED Fiscal, EFD-Contribuições, ECF, ECD, DCTFWeb, REINF, PER/DCOMP e demais declarações aplicáveis.
  • Atuar em iniciativas de monetização de créditos tributários, compensações, pedidos de ressarcimento/restituição, PER/DCOMP, créditos acumulados de ICMS e outras oportunidades de recuperação.
  • Interagir com auditoria externa e interna, apoiando a defesa técnica de posições fiscais, classificação de riscos e atendimento a solicitações de documentação.
  • Apoiar a gestão de fiscalizações, notificações, autos de infração, intimações, malhas fiscais e demais interações com autoridades fiscais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com consultorias externas e escritórios jurídicos na análise de temas tributários relevantes, garantindo alinhamento técnico, documentação adequada e governança.
  • Apoiar a construção de políticas, procedimentos, controles e matrizes de risco tributário.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Tesouraria, Suprimentos, Operações, TI e CSC Fiscal.


Ingredientes Para o Combo:


  • Formação superior em Direito, Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida na área tributária/fiscal em empresas de médio ou grande porte.
  • Forte conhecimento em tributos indiretos, especialmente ICMS, ISS, PIS e COFINS.
  • Conhecimento relevante em tributos diretos, especialmente IRPJ e CSLL.
  • Experiência com retenções tributárias, incluindo IRRF, INSS, ISS, PIS/COFINS/CSLL e demais retenções aplicáveis.
  • Vivência com obrigações acessórias fiscais e contábeis, como SPED Fiscal, EFD-Contribuições, ECF, ECD, DCTFWeb e REINF.
  • Experiência com auditoria externa e/ou interna.
  • Capacidade de avaliar impactos tributários em demonstrações financeiras e indicadores de negócio, como receita líquida, CMV, custos, EBITDA e fluxo de caixa.
  • Experiência com parametrização fiscal, cadastros tributários, NCM, CST, CFOP e regras fiscais em sistemas ERP.
  • Boa capacidade analítica, escrita técnica e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interagir com diferentes áreas da companhia e traduzir temas técnicos em recomendações objetivas para tomada de decisão.


Diferenciais que fazem a diferença:


  • Experiência no setor de varejo, restaurantes, food service, franquias, bens de consumo ou empresas com alto volume transacional.
  • Vivência com SAP, Mastersaf, Synchro, TaxOne, Oracle ou sistemas fiscais equivalentes.
  • Experiência com créditos tributários, PER/DCOMP, ressarcimentos, compensações, e-CredAc, Siscred ou processos similares.
  • Conhecimento sobre regimes especiais, benefícios fiscais estaduais e incentivos fiscais.

  • Experiência em interação com consultorias tributárias, escritórios jurídicos e auditorias independentes.

title: Garena Trainee 2027
description:
Are you ready to turn your passion for gaming into a high-impact career? At Garena, we don’t just play games; we build global communities and manage the operations of the world’s most popular digital entertainment titles—including the global phenomenon Free Fire .


We are looking for fresh graduates to join our Garena Trainee 2027 . From Day 1, you will be embedded into the core of our daily operations, collaborating with talented peers and regional teams across the globe. You will work to support and execute our business strategies with direct guidance and support from local leadership .


Select your track:


Track A: Game Marketing - Focus on how our games reach and resonate with millions. You will master:

  • Performance Marketing & User Acquisition (UA).
  • Branding and Community building.
  • Managing influencer tribes and massive local campaigns.


Track B: Game Operations - Focus on the "engine" that keeps our games alive and profitable. You will master:

  • Game Economy and Monetization strategies.
  • Planning and executing major in-game events.
  • Data analysis to optimize player retention and experience.


Global Sync: Beyond Borders

At Garena, "Global" isn't just a buzzword—it's your daily routine. You will be part of a truly international squad, collaborating daily with our offices in Asia and across the globe . From morning syncs to large-scale global campaign rollouts, you will use your English to navigate different cultures and contribute to a business that never sleeps. If you're looking for a role where your work has no borders, you've found it!


Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:


  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.


Requirements

  • Education: Higher degree (Bacharelado, Tecnólogo ou Licenciatura) completed between Dec/2023 and Dec/2026 .
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, with proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking.
  • Passion for games: You must be an active player, have deep knowledge of gaming mechanics, meta-trends, and player psychology.
  • Availability: able to work in a hybrid model for 8 hours a day in São Paulo/SP.


Why join the Garena Squad?

Joining Garena means entering a high-octane environment where you will deal with the scale and complexity of a global gaming leader. Here, you will be part of a team that tackles real-world business challenges and manages the lifecycle of massive titles in real-time. While you will have access to guidance from experienced professionals and opportunities for professional growth, our focus is on ownership and impact . If you are looking for a fast-paced environment where your work directly affects millions of players, this is the right place for you.


Our Perks & Rewards:

  • Competitive Salary
  • CLT Contract
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Assistance
  • Meal Allowance
  • Transport/Mobility voucher
  • Life Insurance
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Learning Budget: Subsidy for formal and continuing education to keep you leveling up (available after 12 months of service).
  • Childcare Subsidy: Monthly reimbursement for daycare or nanny expenses.
  • Extended Parental Leave: 180 days for maternity leave and 20 days for paternity leave.
  • Travel Insurance


Selection process:

  1. Application via LinkedIn
  2. Online Assessment: Logic & English (Always check your e-mail and spam box!)
  3. HR Interview
  4. Business Case
  5. Case Interview with Hiring Manager
  6. Final Interview with Senior Leadership


Are you ready to Join the Game? Apply now and show us why you are the perfect fit for Garena.

description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

title: Inside Sales & Customer Growth Manager
description:
Location: São Paulo - SP. (Regional scope)

Reports to: Regional Director Brazil & Colombia

Team: Directly manages analysts/executors across four functions (no intermediate leads at this stage), 10 HCs


About the Role

We are looking for a Head Manager of Inside Sales & Customer Growth to lead and structure our Inside Sales operation. This position comes with a clear mission: to become the engine of scalable, replicable, and intelligent customer base growth.

This role currently oversees four distinct functions — inbound lead conversion (hunting), churn account reactivation, remote servicing of small accounts, and sales support — with direct management of each team member.


Mission

Drive scalable, replicable, and intelligent growth of the customer base across the region by directly managing and standardizing the operations of lead conversion, account reactivation, remote account servicing, and commercial support — freeing up the Key Account Management (KAM) team to focus on strategic accounts.


Key Responsibilities

Hunting (Inbound Lead Conversion)

  • Own the process for receiving and converting leads generated through the portal
  • Drive speed-to-lead and improve conversion rate through process discipline and coaching
  • Define and monitor SLAs for response time and follow-up

Churn Reactivation

  • Lead efforts to reactivate churned accounts and recover lost revenue
  • Build a systematic, repeatable approach to identifying and prioritizing reactivation opportunities

Small Accounts (Remote Servicing)

  • Manage remote coverage of small accounts that do not warrant a dedicated KAM
  • Ensure service quality and account growth through efficient, scalable processes

Sales Support

  • Provide operational support to the broader commercial team
  • Ensure fast turnaround and high satisfaction from internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Design and standardize playbooks and processes across all four functions, built to be replicable across countries (Brazil & Colombia)
  • Directly manage, coach, and develop the individuals executing each function
  • Track and report on performance metrics across all four workstreams
  • Partner closely with Marketing, KAMs, Customer Success, and the broader Commercial team to align on lead flow, account handoffs, and shared goals

Success Metrics (6–12 months)

  • Growth in active customer base (%)
  • Standardized, documented processes across all four functions, replicable across countries
  • Improved conversion rate (hunting) and reactivation rate (churn)
  • Team development plan in place, with a clear path toward a squad-lead structure as the operation scales


What We're Looking For

Industry Experience

  • Solid experience in the travel & tourism industry , ideally within online travel platforms (OTAs), booking marketplaces, or tour/travel operators
  • Understanding of how travel distribution works — lead sources, booking cycles, seasonality, and the relationship dynamics between platforms, operators, and agents

Functional / Technical

  • Strong analytical capability — comfortable reading funnel data, conversion metrics, and churn/cohort analysis
  • Process-oriented mindset, with experience designing or improving operational playbooks

Leadership

  • People management experience, ideally across diverse functions or a fast-changing environment
  • Execution discipline — able to drive rhythm, accountability, and results
  • Strong negotiation and cross-functional influence skills — this role depends heavily on alignment with Marketing, KAMs, Customer Success, and Sales

Behavioral

  • Builder mindset — comfortable structuring a function from the ground up in a lean, still-forming regional operation
  • Autonomy and comfort with ambiguity
  • Cultural adaptability, with an eye toward managing teams across multiple countries as the role expands

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Customer Growth roles
  • Experience operating in a regional or multi-country context
  • Portuguese, Spanish and English fluency, given the Brazil & Colombia scope

title: Collections Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the Job

We're building Brazil's largest B2B credit infrastructure, and we're looking for a Collections Analyst who is a true negotiation master to play a key role in that journey. You'll be on the front line of debt recovery, negotiating directly — and skillfully — with a wide range of profiles, from small business owners to C-Level executives at global companies, always finding the angle that gets deals done while building the kind of trust that strengthens Credix's relationships with its clients. But this role goes beyond collecting: you'll think strategically, analyzing delinquency data, surfacing actionable insights, and helping shape the future of our automation-first collections model. If you're a natural dealmaker, a decisive owner, a clear communicator, and thrive in a dynamic credit landscape, this is the role for you.


Qualifications

  • 1–2 year of experience in collections, accounts receivable, customer service, call centers, or operational roles.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers, monitoring payments and driving collection negotiations with the skill of a true dealmaker — efficient, respectful, and always finding a path to resolution.
  • Monitor and control accounts receivable, ensuring financial records are accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Use Excel and SQL to analyze data, track key performance indicators, and manage the collections portfolio. Support the automation of operational processes using Python (preferred) to improve efficiency and streamline workflows.
  • Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies, providing timely and effective solutions.
  • Prioritize competing demands and manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of organization and attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure an excellent customer experience and drive operational efficiency.


Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned client wallet, negotiating like a true master dealmaker over phone and messaging and recovering outstanding debts across varied customer profiles — from small business owners to C-Level executives at global companies.
  • Take ownership of decisions and proactively align with cross-functional teams to solve collection challenges.
  • Prepare daily and weekly reports on recovery rates, DPD trends, and case resolutions.
  • Analyze delinquency data to generate actionable insights that improve collection strategies.
  • Automate repetitive tasks and use tools like Python and SQL to build scripts that improve process efficiency.
  • Identify inefficiencies and implement automated workflows to streamline collections processes.
  • Conduct quality audits of external collection agencies, providing feedback to improve recovery rates.
  • Track performance against KPIs, including recoveries per OKR/Collections Policy and percentage of automated workflows implemented.


What We Offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our São Paulo office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, learn, and grow together.

In addition, we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation, where curiosity is encouraged.
  • Competitive salary package.
  • Equity stock options plan.
  • Paid holidays.
  • Clear growth opportunities within collections and operations.
  • Team off-sites focused on collaboration, fun, and shared experiences.
